title: Sin Tax
subtitle: Revenue expected to reach R$ 41.9 billion in 2027
excerpt: Selective Tax to raise R$ 41.9 billion in 2027
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Selective Tax (IS), known as the "sin tax", is expected to raise R$ 41.9 billion in 2027. This forecast was included in the Annual Budget Law Project (PLOA), which was sent to Congress.

The creation of the Selective Tax was one of the measures of the tax reform. The expected revenue for 2027 is R$ 41.9 billion.

The Selective Tax is one of the main sources of government revenue. The revenue forecast for 2027 is included in the Annual Budget Law Project.

With information from Agência Brasil.
